description: Run a ZOQL query against the configured Zuora tenant and export the full result (up to 50000 rows) to a csv or json blob; returns a result_blob_key. Requires zoql; format is csv (default) or json.
embedding_description: Run a Zuora ZOQL query and export the complete result set as a downloadable csv or json file (blob), for cases where the result is too large or needs to be saved rather than inspected inline. Requires zoql; format defaults to csv.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with result_blob_key (the exported file), row_count, format, and truncated (true if the export hit the 50000-row cap).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the row_count, format, and truncated flag; the result_blob_key references sensitive billing/financial content (data_sensitivity 0.5) — surface for downstream use but never treat as public.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Export a Zuora ZOQL query result to a blob.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing zoql or an unsupported format. zuora.query_failed: the ZOQL is invalid. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.query_failed: fix the ZOQL syntax and object/field names before exporting.
